rv.q: His attention to dynamics enlivened the vibrant, supple carpet of orchestral sound, an important factor in making this performance so moving.
This production is certainly for someone.

cn.t: Michael Mayer's Met production of La Traviata elicits mixed reactions, with critics finding the lavish, jewel-toned costumes eye-catching but the overall aesthetic overstuffed and garish, losing impact after its initial visual dazzle.
